empty.title: Paste a link to begin
empty.routing: Direct files go through aria2, media links through yt-dlp.
empty.cookies: Private or age-gated videos need a cookie jar — Cookies tab.
setup.needs: edownloader needs {names} to download from YouTube and other sites.
setup.origin: from each project's official releases, checksums verified where published
setup.purpose.aria2: fast, resumable direct links and magnets
setup.purpose.ffmpeg: merging video and audio, MP4 output
setup.unsupported: automatic installation is not available on this system
setup.system_package: {names}: install it with your distribution's package manager (for example: sudo dnf install aria2, or sudo apt install aria2).
setup.checksum_mismatch: {file} does not match the checksum {tool} publishes; nothing was installed
setup.in_use: {file} is in use; let the running downloads finish, then try again
update.ready_banner: edownloader {version} is ready. It installs when you close the app, or now:
cookies.no_jars: No jars yet. Import cookies below.
cookies.domain_hint: Target domain — only needed for a Cookie: header
cookies.accepts: Accepts Netscape cookies.txt, cookie-editor JSON, or name=value pairs.
cookies.none_line1: YouTube asks for a signed-in session on many links.
cookies.none_line2: Export cookies.txt with a browser extension, then paste it.
cookies.none_line3: The active jar is handed to yt-dlp automatically.
cookies.col.name: name
cookies.signin_rule: Sign-in needs SID/__Secure-*PSID together with LOGIN_INFO.
cookies.names_ok: Names look right; only a real download proves the session still works.
cookies.other_site: This jar belongs to {domain}. It is still handed to yt-dlp for that site.
settings.language_hint: System follows your computer's display language.
settings.theme_hint: Catppuccin flavours; system follows the desktop.
settings.concurrency_hint: Queued links start as slots free up.
settings.connections_hint: Parallel connections for direct links (aria2) and stream fragments (HLS, DASH; at most 8).
settings.format_hint: Used for every new media link.
settings.container_hint: MP4 first, for broad compatibility; native keeps the best codecs as WebM.
settings.playlists_hint: Off follows only the linked item.
settings.metadata_hint: Tags the file with title, artist and artwork.
settings.send_jar: Send the active jar to yt-dlp
settings.send_jar_hint: Needed for private, age-gated or bot-checked links.
settings.browser_hint: Some builds block extraction — paste a cookies.txt then.
settings.check_updates_hint: New versions download in the background and install when you close the app.
tools.js_missing: not found — install Deno or Node.js
tools.js_ready_hint: Solves YouTube's signature challenge; without it YouTube only offers storyboards.
tools.js_missing_hint: Without a JS runtime YouTube throttles signed-in downloads to storyboards.
tools.location_hint: Installed in the local app-data folder; yt-dlp should be refreshed whenever a site stops working.
tools.ytdlp_missing: yt-dlp is not installed: install it from Settings › tools
tools.aria2_missing: aria2 is not installed: install it from Settings › tools
notice.update_ready: Version {version} is ready: restart to install it.
notice.ytdlp_for_browser: yt-dlp is required to read cookies out of a browser.
notice.test_no_auth: No YouTube authentication cookies in this jar.
notice.test_not_youtube: This jar has no youtube.com cookies.
browser.app_bound: This browser protects its cookies with app-bound encryption, so nothing can be read out of it. Export cookies.txt with a browser extension and use “Paste cookies” instead.
browser.nothing_read: No cookies could be read from {browser}. Is it installed, and are you signed in?
link.scheme: Only http(s) and magnet links are supported.
link.not_a_link: That does not look like a link.
link.blob: A blob: link only exists inside the browser tab that made it. Paste the page's address instead.
import.header_needs_domain: This looks like a `Cookie:` header — enter its domain first (for example youtube.com).
import.unrecognized: Unrecognized cookie format. Accepted: Netscape cookies.txt, JSON (cookie-editor), or a Cookie: header plus a domain.
import.netscape_empty: No cookies found in that Netscape file.
import.json_invalid: That JSON could not be parsed: {error}
import.json_invalid_expected: That JSON could not be parsed: {error}. Expected an array of cookie objects.
import.json_not_array: Expected a JSON array of cookie objects.
import.json_no_objects: That JSON held no cookie objects.
import.json_unnamed.one: {n} JSON object found, but it did not carry both a domain and a name.
import.json_unnamed.other: {n} JSON objects found, but none carried both a domain and a name.
import.header_domain_required: A domain is required for Cookie header import.
import.header_no_pairs: No `name=value` pairs found in that header.
error.signin: YouTube wants a signed-in session for this link. Import your cookies (Cookies tab) and retry.
error.js_failed: YouTube's JavaScript challenge could not be solved even with the detected runtime — update yt-dlp.
error.js_missing: YouTube needs a JavaScript runtime to unlock its formats. Install Deno or Node.js, then retry.
error.no_formats_cookies: YouTube offered no playable formats: the cookie jar is expired or not signed in. Re-export cookies.txt and retry.
error.no_formats: This link has no downloadable formats (live stream, premiere or region lock).
error.dpapi: The browser refused cookie decryption (Chrome's app-bound encryption). Export cookies.txt from a browser extension and import that instead.
error.private: This video is private — the cookie jar must belong to an account that can see it.
error.unavailable: The site reports this item unavailable, or not available from your region.
error.http403: The server refused the request (403). Cookies from that site usually fix it.
error.http403_stream: The stream refused the request (403): a copied .m3u8 or .mpd link loses the page's access. Paste the address of the page that plays it.
error.http429: Rate limited (429). Wait a little, or authenticate with cookies.
error.drm: This content is protected by DRM: no downloader of this kind can save it.
error.members: Members-only video: the cookie jar must belong to a member account.
error.scheduled: This is a scheduled stream that has not started yet.
error.network: The site could not be reached. Check the connection or retry.
pinterest.unsupported: This Pinterest link is not a pin, a board or a board section. Paste the link of one of those.
pinterest.not_found: Pinterest has nothing at this address: the pin or board was removed, or it is secret. For your own secret boards, import cookies from a browser signed in to Pinterest.
pinterest.denied: Pinterest refused: this board is secret or private. Import cookies from a browser signed in to Pinterest, then retry.
gallery.not_found: {site} has nothing at this address: the post was deleted, or the link is wrong.
gallery.private: {site} does not show this post to visitors: it is private, age-restricted or deleted. If your account can see it, import cookies from a browser signed in to {site}, then retry.
gallery.rate_limited: {site} is limiting requests for now. Wait a few minutes, then retry: the files already downloaded are kept.
gallery.changed: {site} answered in an unexpected way; its site may have changed.
gallery.no_media: This post has no picture or video to download.
gallery.no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg is needed to save this video. Install the tools from the banner, then retry.
gallery.partial.one: {n} of {total} files could not be downloaded ({error}). Retry to fetch only that one.
gallery.partial.other: {n} of {total} files could not be downloaded ({error}). Retry to fetch only those.
